name: Flat vector space explainer
summary: Friendly flat-colour planets orbit a glowing sun, with moons, parallax stars and a labelled planet.
bestFor: Astronomy lessons and kids' science explainers
prompt: Make a friendly flat vector explainer about the solar system. Show the sun with a gentle glow, then let each planet pop in on its own circular orbit. Add a small moon to a couple of planets, highlight one planet with a label, and finish with a calm summary line. Use a deep purple space background and bright, rich colours.
